activity_summary: Alone, you repeated the sum and the season, and you said neither the money nor the roof goes into the book. You kept Field and the tiring-house out of it. You stopped.

facets.activity: Did not enter the six hundred

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Neither of them goes in the book.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The printer did not hear it.
